capabilities: Pin folders and tags as navigation tabs
Group tabs into collapsible stacks and sections
Customize tabs with icons, colors, and display names
Browse bookmarks, recent files, reminders, and trash in a side panel
Show file content snippets below filenames
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not about links or embeds; it is a customizable replacement view for browsing files, folders, and tags.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. The README warns to back up .obsidian/plugins/portals/data.json before plugin updates. Full guide is hosted externally. On mobile it works best with the Baseline theme, otherwise floating navigation must be turned off.
intentEvidence: Portals enhances your Obsidian file navigation by letting you pin any folder or tag as a customisable tab
problem: The default file explorer offers few ways to keep frequently used folders and tags pinned, organized, and visually distinguished while navigating.
summary: File browser that pins folders and tags as customizable tabs with icons, colors, stacks, plus a side panel with bookmarks, recents, and notes.
